messages:
Priya: paging — deploy bot just reported a failed rollout for svc-inference v2.3.0, multiple 5xx spikes from canary hosts. @inc-bot please annotate timeline :rotating_light:
inc-bot: Incident created (INC-2025-0427). Pager sent to oncall (Priya). Initial severity: P2.
Eli: seeing huge latency on /v1/generate from CANARY-02 and CANARY-03, 500s and timeouts. Non-canary traffic currently still fine but error rate climbing. Dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/ops/serving/svc-inference
Sam: paging in — on call. what's the canary traffic split?
Priya: 10% to canary cluster. Canary appears to have a regression after the new KV cache + micro-batching change. Logs show OOM-ish traces and worker restarts.
Jess: support is getting customer pings about "long responses" from some users on hosted tier. Not widespread yet, but a few enterprise customers hit. Logged to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-0427
Eli: I can roll traffic down to 0 for canary from the router, or flip the config to route to stable. Sam — want me to divert?
Sam: yes, divert now. Also, let's flip the feature flag for the KV change to off: ffctl set svc-inference.kv_optimize false --env production. Priya, coordinate with support for customer comms.
Priya: on it. Running divert now -> `routerctl set-split svc-inference 90:stable,10:canary --to 100:stable`
Eli: router reports split change accepted. Traffic to canary dropping. Error rate falling from 12% -> 1.8% within 30s.
inc-bot: Automated rollback attempt failed earlier due to a lock on the deploy pipeline (deploy-lock held by a CI job). Manual intervention required.
Sam: note: automated rollback is disabled for this model family; manual revert required because of migrations. We'll coordinate a hot revert instead of full rollback to avoid DB changes.
Jess: support pushed a short status update to affected customers: "Investigating increased latency affecting a subset of requests. We are diverting traffic and will update shortly." :mailbox_with_mail:
Priya: ok, plan: 1) keep canary traffic at 0%, 2) flip feature flag `kv_optimize` to off, 3) perform a manual revert of runtime config on canaries, 4) verify with smoke e2e and metrics, 5) notify customers.
Eli: starting FF toggle now. Running: `ffctl set svc-inference.kv_optimize false --no-wait`
Eli: FF toggle succeeded. Noted that the flag is evaluated at request time for this codepath, so new requests should avoid the path immediately.
Sam: I'll drain and restart the two canary nodes to clear KV caches: `k8s rollout restart ds/canary-inference --selector=canary=true -n inference`
Priya: starting customer impact assessment: affected customers list small (4 orgs), none on Dedicated. Most are hosted trial users. Escalation level: keep at P2, re-evaluate in 30m.
support-bot: Noted. Creating support tickets for the 4 affected orgs and attaching correlation id list.
Eli: canary node restarts in progress. Logs show preflight errors on startup referencing a new kernel flag in runtime (kv_prefetch_mode). That wasn't in the stable build. Looks like the canary image included an extra runtime tweak.
Sam: that's the problem. Image v2.3.0 bundled runtime-gamma with kv_prefetch_mode=?; stable uses runtime-beta. We need to pin canary back to runtime-beta.
Priya: do we have a quick image revert? `registryctl promote --from redwood/svc-inference:stable-runtime-beta --to redwood/svc-inference:canary-temp`
Eli: image promote in progress. CI shows the registry promotion succeeded. Updating daemonset to point to promoted tag.
inc-bot: CI pipeline event: manual deploy initiated by Eli at 175432+130s.
Eli: updated canary DS to use promoted image, pods are creating. Health probes passing on 3/3 for CANARY-02 within 45s.
Priya: metrics: p95 latency back to baseline on stable path; canary error rate 0.5% and trending down.
Sam: run smoke verification: `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer smoke-token' https://canary.svc.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status` -> returns OK and latency 120ms.
Jess: support ready to send customer follow-up with ETA. Recommend mention that we diverted traffic and applied a hot revert; a postmortem will follow.
Priya: agreeing. Also add follow-up for Dedicated customers to remind them this didn't impact their isolated infra.
Eli: moving to keep watch for 20m; will re-enable gradual canary split only after 1hr observation and a canary-release checklist pass.
Sam: checklist: unit metrics, p95, error rate <0.5%, no OOMs, thread dumps sampled, canary logs scrubbed.
inc-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated. Severity downgraded to P3 at 1754330500.
Priya: handoff — I'm off in 40m. Eli, can you own the post-mitigation verification and postmortem draft?
Eli: I will. I'll collect the trace spans and perf diffs and draft the RCA. Sam — can you include runtime kernel selection decision notes?
Sam: yes. I'll add the bit about runtime-gamma pushing kv_prefetch_mode and why the automation didn't catch it.
Jess: I'll coordinate customer comms and the public status page follow-up.
Priya: final note — add a follow-up action: add a deploy gate that rejects images with unknown runtime flags for canary family. Filing action: ACTION-INC-2025-0427-1.
support-bot: Action ticket created and assigned to eng-platform.
Eli: closing channel updates. If anyone sees a regression ping here or @pager.
Priya: thanks team. Good response. :thumbsup:
